_readme: Copy to config/filters.json and point RADAR_FILTERS at it. Unset RADAR_FILTERS,
or a path that does not exist, means no filtering at all. A file that exists but
does not parse is a hard error -- silently tracking every posting on every board
would be far worse than a crash.
Matching is substring-based on a case- and diacritic-folded form, so 'werkstudent'
catches 'München' / 'MÜNCHEN'. It does NOT expand 'ue' ('Muenchen' is a separate
entry below) and it never translates ('Munich' is another separate entry).
Wrap a term in '|' to pin it to word edges: '|intern|' matches the word Intern but
not 'International' or 'Internal'. '|internship' matches Internship anywhere a word
starts. Use this for short English stems; German compounds want the loose form.
Changing anything here re-baselines every affected source on the next poll: rows
are refreshed, nothing is closed, no closure alerts fire. That is deliberate --
filters run before the diff, so tightening one would otherwise mass-close live
postings. Cosmetic edits (key order, whitespace, casing, list order) are ignored.
